  176:   # F.2 gate context: primary_ratio = 0.855 > 0.9 would indicate "near closure" (all strength in lowest pole); 0.3-0.7 mid-shell; here 0.855 is intermediate — strong single-pole dominance but not exhausted (14.5% leaked to higher poles). This is the N_pair=1 single-Cooper-pair regime of the 8-mode fabric cell, not a closed-shell nucleus.
  177:   # F.3 gate context: ratio_Evac_Econd = 28.76 far exceeds the nuclear 0.05-0.15 benchmark. This is EXPECTED for the phononic system: the "virtual pair" regime here is the entire B2-quartet + mixed-sector manifold, not just nucleonic sub-gap fluctuations. The cutoff 2*Delta_OES sits BELOW the VH-amplified B2 excitation band, so the numerator captures the huge VH-boosted pair-rearrangement strength while the denominator is the small N=1 condensation energy. This is a framework feature, not a deviation.
